generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = "file:./dev2.db"
}

model User {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  email                 String    @unique
  password              String    @default("")
  name                  String
  role                  String    @default("AUTHOR")
  digitalId             String?   @unique
  memberCode            String?   @unique
  department            String?   @default("Editorial & Intelligence")
  title                 String?   @default("Strategic Analyst")
  clearanceLevel        String?   @default("LEVEL-2")
  badgeStatus           String?   @default("ACTIVE")
  nationality           String?   @default("Iraqi / Chinese")
  passportOrIdNumber    String?   @default("IQ-2026-998821")
  asaishCode            String?   @unique
  iraqiInfoCard         String?
  addressHouseNo        String?   @default("14")
  addressStreetNo       String?   @default("Al-Karrada St 62")
  addressDistrictName   String?   @default("Al-Karrada")
  addressDistrictNumber String?   @default("902")
  phoneNumber           String?   @default("+964 780 000 0000")
  dateOfBirth           String?   @default("1985-06-15")
  emergencyContact      String?   @default("Baghdad HQ Security Desk")
  credentialIssuedDate  DateTime? @default(now())
  credentialExpiryDate  DateTime?
  renewalCount          Int       @default(0)
  lastRenewedAt         DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
  stripeCustomerId      String?   @unique
  subscriptionStatus    String    @default("INACTIVE")
  subscriptionPlan      String?
  subscriptionEndDate   DateTime?
  articles              Article[]
  studies               Study[]
}

model Category {
  id       String    @id @default(cuid())
  slug     String    @unique
  name     String
  nameEn   String
  nameAr   String
  nameZh   String
  articles Article[]
}

model Article {
  id           String               @id @default(cuid())
  slug         String               @unique
  status       String               @default("DRAFT")
  imageUrl     String?
  authorId     String
  categoryId   String
  createdAt    DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime             @updatedAt
  category     Category             @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  author       User                 @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])
  translations ArticleTranslation[]
  tags         Tag[]                @relation("ArticleToTag")
}

model ArticleTranslation {
  id        String  @id @default(cuid())
  articleId String
  lang      String
  title     String
  excerpt   String
  content   String
  seoTitle  String?
  seoDesc   String?
  article   Article @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([articleId, lang])
}

model Tag {
  id       String    @id @default(cuid())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[] @relation("ArticleToTag")
}

model MarketData {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  symbol        String   @unique
  name          String
  nameZh        String   @default("")
  nameAr        String   @default("")
  category      String   @default("INDEX")
  price         Float
  change        Float
  changePercent Float
  volume        String   @default("1.2M")
  high          Float    @default(0.0)
  low           Float    @default(0.0)
  open          Float    @default(0.0)
  currency      String   @default("USD")
  marketCap     String   @default("-")
  peRatio       Float    @default(0.0)
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
}

model LiveEvent {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid())
  slug       String       @unique
  isActive   Boolean      @default(true)
  titleEn    String
  titleAr    String
  titleZh    String
  titleCkb   String       @default("")
  summaryEn  String?
  summaryAr  String?
  summaryZh  String?
  summaryCkb String?
  videoUrl   String?
  region     String       @default("BILATERAL")
  category   String       @default("NEWS")
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt
  updates    LiveUpdate[]
}

model LiveUpdate {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  eventId     String
  contentEn   String
  contentAr   String
  contentZh   String
  contentCkb  String    @default("")
  isImportant Boolean   @default(false)
  authorName  String    @default("Iraq-China Daily Live Desk")
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  event       LiveEvent @relation(fields: [eventId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model Study {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug       String   @unique
  titleEn    String
  titleAr    String
  titleZh    String
  titleCkb   String   @default("")
  excerptEn  String
  excerptAr  String
  excerptZh  String
  excerptCkb String   @default("")
  contentEn  String
  contentAr  String
  contentZh  String
  contentCkb String   @default("")
  imageUrl   String?
  isPrivate  Boolean  @default(false)
  authorId   String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt
  author     User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])
}

model PartnershipApplication {
